title: REALM: A Dataset of Real-World LLM Use Cases
measurement_description: The paper does not measure or evaluate any aspect of faith or religion. It categorizes LLM use cases by occupation, and 'Religious Workers' is included as one of many sub-categories within the 'Community and Social Service' profession.
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study. The professional category 'Religious Workers' was included in the occupational taxonomy but was not analyzed separately.
